question: What mantra of śakti-seed essence should the practitioner recite?
premises: The practitioner is to recite a gāyatrī.
This gāyatrī has the essential form of the śakti-seed.
inference: The practitioner should recite the gāyatrī whose essence is the śakti-seed.
plain_english: The practitioner should recite the gāyatrī whose own form is the śakti-seed.
